WoW: Forever

Holy Paladin

Plate-wearing single-target healer with party-wide Blessings and auras, and Forever finally gives it an area-healing answer through the new Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3Cast1.5 sec castCost730 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownApplies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 175 to 189 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for 326 to 344. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party. capstone.

WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated October 31, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. Talents open at level 10. The one-point gold medal talents sit at 11, 21 and 31 points spent, joined in Forever by a new 16-point gold medal, and Dual Specialization unlocks at 40. These pages follow the hotfix Blizzard pushed to the launch realms on October 30, read from the game's hotfix data. Blizzard has not announced it, so it may still move before November 4.

Blizzard's Paladin deep dive went up on October 15 and this page is written from it and the launch client. Where the dive speaks, the claim below is Blizzard's and says so, and where the launch realms have since moved a figure, this page gives the current one. A hover tooltip reads the base client, so it can lag a hotfix: where a tooltip and the prose differ, the prose is right.

Improved Holy StrikeImproved Holy StrikeTalentCastInstantReduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 2 sec. is gone, and its shorter cooldown is baseline: Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage. sits on 10 seconds for everyone. A published level-20 "Holy damage" build spends two points on that talent, and they can no longer be entered.

Two kinds of caveat run through these pages and they do not mean the same thing. Something marked as ours is our own reasoning rather than a source's. A client or guide-site reading is a number Blizzard has not published.

No source had posted a level 30 build when this page was written, and the published level 20 builds no longer fit the tree. So both builds below are our own; no guide recommends them.

What Holy is for

Keeping a party standing while in plate, with the mana tools to keep doing it. Blizzard's own summary is that Holy sustains heals on a single target better than anything else in the game, that healing a whole party at once takes more planning, and that the new talents make Holy a viable healer across every form of group play. ReverenceReverenceTalentCastInstantAllows 30% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting. keeps 30% of your Spirit-driven mana regeneration running while you cast. IlluminationIlluminationTalentCastInstant refunds 50% of a spell's base cost when it procs.

The new Light's VigilLight's VigilTalent · Rank 1 of 3Cast1.5 sec castCost730 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown6 sec cooldownApplies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 175 to 189 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for 326 to 344. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party. capstone is the party-healing half of that. Mark an ally, and your next Holy ShockHoly ShockLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost160 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownBlasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally. on them triggers no cooldown and heals their whole party.

Underneath all of that you are still a melee Paladin: keep a seal up and press Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage. and JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost6% of base ManaRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. on cooldown. Blizzard made that easier to hold together. JudgementJudgementLevel 4 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost6% of base ManaRange10 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownUnleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. no longer consumes your active Seal, and Holy StrikeHoly StrikeLevel 6 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost5 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownAn instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage. trains at level 6 for 50% of your weapon damage plus a flat Holy bonus that grows with each rank, though the rank you actually train there reads 25% of weapon damage plus 12 Holy in the client, on a 10-second cooldown.

Dungeon quests reward 50% less extra experience beyond normal quest values, which Blizzard framed as a deliberate reduction in levelling speed. Kills inside dungeons pay about 20% more, so dungeons stay open to a Holy Paladin (ours, not a source's).

No source publishes a levelling score for any Paladin spec. A score would only measure solo kill speed, not whether the spec works.

Our own reading, not a sourced one: most of what Holy produces lands on other people, because the Blessings, auras and heals all apply to the party. The tree does buy damage, and that part is Blizzard's: Consecrated GroundConsecrated GroundTalentCastInstantGives your Holy spells 10% increased damage against the first 4 enemies that enter your Consecration. raises Holy spell damage, Divine PrecisionDivine PrecisionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%. supplies its Hit, and the dive says Holy gains new tools for spell-focused damage.

Stat priority

Healing Power, then Intellect, MP5, critical strike, Haste, Spirit.

If you are not planning to heal seriously, gear Weapon Damage, Hit and critical strike instead and play the Holy-damage path.

Blizzard says it does not plan to itemize Hit chance on plate healing gear, and that Divine PrecisionDivine PrecisionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%. is there to supply it instead: up to 8% Hit with Holy spells and 20% shorter Silences, 2 points in row 4, with no Holy ShockHoly ShockLevel 30 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost160 ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown10 sec cooldownBlasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally. requirement. On the Holy-damage path that talent is where your spell Hit comes from, not your gear.

At level 60

Unknown: whether the Holy-damage "Shockadin" path holds up as a raid specialisation. Blizzard clearly intends it to exist.
